# Notification centre (`notification-centre`)

Notifications with actions, grouped and dismissible, critical ones pinned on top.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createNotificationCentre` (types in `dist/web/home/info/notificationCentre.d.ts`): `section.mh-notification-centre`: a `__header` (`__title`, `__count`, "Clear all"), then the pinned critical notifications (`__section--pinned`) and one `__section` per group, each with a `__section-title` and a `__list` of `li.mh-notification` (`--critical | --high | --low`, `.is-unread`): `__icon`, `__body` (`__top` with `__title` and `__time`, `__message`, `__actions`) and a `__dismiss` button. A long group folds behind a `__more` toggle. When a dismissed notification goes, focus moves to the next one (or the centre itself).

```ts
export function createNotificationCentre(options: NotificationCentreOptions): NotificationCentreHandle;

export interface NotificationCentreOptions {
  notifications: readonly NotificationItem[];
  /** Shows the title row (heading, count, "Clear all"); default true. The title stays the accessible name either way. */
  header?: boolean;
  /** Level of the title (default 2); group headings are one below. */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  /** A group longer than this shows its first ones and a "Show n more" button (default 3; 0 never folds). */
  collapseAfter?: number;
  onAction?: (id: string, actionId: string) => void;
  onDismiss?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Shows "Clear all"; called with the ids of every dismissible notification. */
  onClearAll?: (ids: string[]) => void;
  labels?: Partial<NotificationCentreLabels>;
}

export interface NotificationCentreHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** Applies changed options; omitted ones keep their value. */
  update(changes: Partial<NotificationCentreOptions>): void;
}

export interface NotificationItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  message?: string | null;
  /** Shown as given ("2 min ago", "07:42"). */
  time?: string | null;
  /** Leading icon (default: a bell; an alert sign for critical and high). */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Notifications with the same group are listed together under its name. */
  group?: string | null;
  priority?: NotificationPriority;
  actions?: readonly NotificationAction[];
  /** Default: every notification but a critical one, when `onDismiss` is set. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  unread?: boolean;
}

export interface NotificationCentreLabels {
  /** The heading and accessible name. */
  title: string;
  /** Heading of the pinned critical notifications. */
  pinned: string;
  /** Heading of notifications without a group, when there are groups. */
  other: string;
  /** Spoken before a critical notification's title. */
  critical: string;
  /** Spoken before an unread notification's title. */
  unread: string;
  dismiss: (title: string) => string;
  clearAll: string;
  empty: string;
  showMore: (count: number) => string;
  showLess: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiDoorOpen, mdiWashingMachine, mdiWaterAlert } from '@mdi/js';
import { createNotificationCentre, type NotificationItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let notifications: NotificationItem[] = [
  {
    id: 'leak',
    title: 'Water under the kitchen sink',
    message: 'The leak sensor has been wet for 2 minutes.',
    priority: 'critical',
    icon: mdiWaterAlert,
    time: 'Now',
    actions: [{ id: 'valve', label: 'Close main valve', tone: 'primary' }],
  },
  { id: 'door', title: 'Back door left open', group: 'Security', icon: mdiDoorOpen, time: '10 min' },
  { id: 'washer', title: 'Washing finished', group: 'Appliances', icon: mdiWashingMachine, time: '12 min' },
];

const without = (ids: string[]): void => {
  notifications = notifications.filter((n) => !ids.includes(n.id));
  centre.update({ notifications });
};

const centre = createNotificationCentre({
  notifications,
  onAction: (id) => without([id]),
  onDismiss: (id) => without([id]),
  onClearAll: without,
});

document.body.append(centre.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { mdiDoorOpen, mdiWashingMachine, mdiWaterAlert } from '@mdi/js';
import { NotificationCentre } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { NotificationItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function NotificationCentreExample() {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<NotificationItem[]>([
    {
      id: 'leak',
      title: 'Water under the kitchen sink',
      message: 'The leak sensor has been wet for 2 minutes.',
      priority: 'critical',
      icon: mdiWaterAlert,
      time: 'Now',
      actions: [{ id: 'valve', label: 'Close main valve', tone: 'primary' }],
    },
    { id: 'door', title: 'Back door left open', group: 'Security', icon: mdiDoorOpen, time: '10 min' },
    { id: 'washer', title: 'Washing finished', group: 'Appliances', icon: mdiWashingMachine, time: '12 min' },
  ]);
  const without = (ids: string[]) => setNotifications((list) => list.filter((n) => !ids.includes(n.id)));
  return (
    <NotificationCentre
      notifications={notifications}
      onAction={(id) => without([id])}
      onDismiss={(id) => without([id])}
      onClearAll={without}
    />
  );
}
```
